subject: Proration & Credit for Mid-cycle Service Transition — Carrivox
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Oliver King <oliver.king@carrivox.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example
Cc: Lina Petrov <lina.petrov@carrivox.com>, procurement@carrivox.com
Date: 21 May 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Change of plan mid-cycle — proration & VAT question

Hi Soojin,

Quick one from our side — we're planning to move Carrivox from a Dedicated Reserved pool (3x V100 equivalent) to Redwood Hosted API starting 26 May. We also want to add the 'Embeddings-Plus' add-on for the remainder of our current billing month.

Can you confirm how you will calculate the pro-rated credit for the unused portion of our Dedicated commitment and whether that credit is applied to the next invoice or refunded? Also: we are an EU-registered company and need to know how VAT will be handled for the proration/credit and for the add-on charge if we provide a VAT ID.

We need this to finalize our PO and internal approvals; can we get a draft invoice/credit note and expected timeline for issuing any refunds?

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver King
Head of Platform Ops, Carrivox Ltd


On 21 May 2026 09:03, soojin_lee@redwood.example wrote:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>
To: Oliver King <oliver.king@carrivox.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example, aditya_rao@redwood.example
Date: 21 May 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Change of plan mid-cycle — proration & VAT question

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up. Short answers up front:

- Proration method: daily pro-rata based on the calendar days in the current billing period. We calculate the unused portion of the reserved capacity (commit minus actual consumption) from the change date (26 May) through the end of your current billing month and issue a credit equal to that pro-rated amount.
- Rounding & minimums: credits are calculated to the nearest cent and any per-month minimums or early-termination fees in your signed SOW will be considered (I checked — no early-termination penalty in your SOW).
- Application of credit: credits are applied to the next invoice by default. If you prefer a refund to the original payment method, Finance can issue a bank transfer after you approve the credit note.
- VAT: if Carrivox provides a valid EU VAT ID, we will treat the credit and new hosted charges under reverse-charge (no VAT charged on our invoice). If no valid VAT ID is supplied, we must charge UK VAT at the applicable rate for the billed amount on the invoice. Please share your VAT registration number and the billing entity legal name.

I've looped in Neha (Finance) to prepare a draft credit note and the interim invoice for the add-on. Aditya will gather usage/consumption logs for the Dedicated instance to reconcile actual usage in the calculation.

Action items for Carrivox:
1) Share billing legal name + VAT ID (if available)
2) Confirm whether you want the credit applied to next invoice or refunded to the card/bank
3) Confirm effective switch date (you mentioned 26 May — confirm)

I'll follow up with the drafts within the day.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference


On 21 May 2026 11:12:00 +0100, neha_kapoor@redwood.example wrote:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>
To: Oliver King <oliver.king@carrivox.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.example
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.example
Subject: Draft credit note & add-on invoice (Carrivox)

Hi all — attaching the draft credit note and a short interim invoice for the Embeddings-Plus add-on covering 26 May — 31 May.

Summary (draft):
- Reserved capacity monthly commitment: EUR 12,000 (monthly)
- Billing period: 1 May — 31 May 2026
- Days used as Dedicated: 1 May — 25 May (25 days)
- Days hosted after change: 26 May — 31 May (6 days)
- Daily commitment rate = 12,000 / 31 = EUR 387.10/day (rounded)
- Unused reserved days (from 26 May onward): 6 days 
- Pro-rated credit = 387.10 * 6 = EUR 2,322.60 (draft)

Add-on interim charge (Embeddings-Plus): pro-rated for 6 days at plan daily rate (Embeddings-Plus monthly = EUR 900 -> EUR 29.03/day -> 29.03*6 = EUR 174.18)

Net effect: credit EUR 2,322.60 applied against add-on EUR 174.18 -> Remaining credit EUR 2,148.42 to apply to next invoice or refund.

VAT treatment: we will issue the documents without VAT if we receive a valid EU VAT ID for Carrivox and the supplied VAT ID validates in VIES. If you do not provide a VAT ID by the time we finalize, we will include VAT at 20% on the add-on interim invoice and the credit note will reflect the gross amounts.

Required from Carrivox to finalize:
- VAT ID + legal billing name (for reverse charge)
- PO number if you require PO on invoice
- Confirmation on refund vs credit application

Attachments: 20260521-carrivox-prorate-draft-invoice.pdf, 20260521-credit-note-draft.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference


On 21 May 2026 12:05:00 +0100, aditya_rao@redwood.example wrote:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example, Oliver King <oliver.king@carrivox.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Subject: Dedicated usage logs for proration

Hi Oliver — Per Soojin's note, attached are the consumption logs we use to reconcile actual usage for the Dedicated pool. The numbers used in Neha's draft are based on committed monthly charge and the calendar-day proration method. If you want a per-token/GB reconciliation instead of calendar-day, let me know and I can run that — it typically changes the credit by a small amount for customers with bursty traffic.

Attached: dedicated-usage-logs-2026-05.csv (summary rows included in draft invoice)

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Soojin / Neha / Aditya. That all looks sensible. A couple quick notes:

1) Carrivox legal billing name: Carrivox Ltd (Ireland). VAT ID: IE6381234F - we'll attach the confirmation certificate in a follow-up.
2) Please apply the remaining credit to our next invoice rather than a bank refund. PO number will be CVX-PO-6672.
3) Confirmed switch date 26 May.

Please send the finalized credit note and interim invoice with PO and VAT details included. If you can get the documents into DocuSign for signature (amendment to SOW) that would help our procurement team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Oliver
